SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS totalAssignedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) AS completedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 END) AS inProgressCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.status = 'not_started' THEN 1 END) AS notStartedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND ce.expired_at < NOW() THEN 1 END) AS expiredCount, IFNULL( CONCAT( ROUND( (COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 END), 0), 1 ), '%' ), '0.0%' ) AS completionRate FROM course_enrollment ce WHERE ce.is_deleted = 0
AND ce.company_id = #{companyId}
